thread:
jamie: quick debrief from the token-fetch / 502 spike yesterday. paging was noisy and handoff felt fuzzy. want to propose a short action list + follow-up automation.
priya: agree. paging volume was high because retries + our alert threshold. we had 6 duplicate pages for the same user-requested flow :/  
priya: also customer impact summary: ~17 customers saw elevated error rates for ~8m; two noticed in prod. CS pinged us at 10:12 and we didn't have a compact customer-impact blurb ready to paste.
troy: big ops note — during the handoff at 10:28 we didn't have the incident timeline nicely collapsed, so oncall had to re-run queries. that added ~7m to mitigation.
alina: +1. Handoff checklist missing: current mitigation, outstanding risk, who owns follow-up. small things but they add up.
jamie: proposed concrete steps:
- update incident-bot to include a one-click "customer-impact blurb" generated from last 10m error/traffic metrics
- reduce duplicate pages by dedup window tweak + grouping by incident_id
- add a compact handoff template that incident-bot posts at handoff time
- schedule postmortem and create tracked action items in the action dashboard automatically
priya: I sketched a postmortem-template v2. gist: ```
Summary: short one-line impact
Timeline: bullet points (ts - event)
Root cause: hypothesis + signal
Mitigations: what we did
Follow-ups: owner, ETA, priority
Customer impact: list of orgs, severity
``` 
priya: also added field `customer_blurb` which is a 2-line sentence ready for CS copy/paste.
jamie: love it. can we also have the incident-bot post a short summary to #support automatically when incident reaches P1 for >5m? that would reduce the frantic CS DM.
troy: technical bits: bot can call /metrics api and build blurb. pseudocode:
```
metrics = GET /api/metrics?since=now-10m&filter=errors
blurb = f"{sum(metrics.errors)} errors across {metrics.unique_customers} customers in last 10m; affected endpoints: {top_endpoints}"
post_to_channel('#support', blurb)
```
alina: on the deduping: current alerting groups by `resource` only. we should group by `incident_signature` (hash of error type + stack + endpoint). reduces noisy pages.
incident-bot: Automated note: I can create an action ticket when a postmortem is scheduled. Use `/incident-bot create-pm` to auto-provision the doc and linked issue. :robot_face:
jamie: nice — toggle idea: incident-bot creates the postmortem doc draft but doesn't publish until owner confirms. also add a `handoff` flag that triggers the compact handoff template.
priya: scheduling: I can run the postmortem scheduler if someone assigns owners. propose: owner must be assigned within 24h of incident close, PM/eng + SRE to attend within 7 days.
jamie: owner assignment flow:
1) incident-bot suggests owners based on recent deploys + oncall history
2) pager assigns, or oncall confirms within 24h
3) incident-bot opens a tracking card in the action dashboard (link pr: https://tiny.redwood/action-dashboard)
alina: for the action dashboard: we need columns: action, owner, due, status, CI impact, linked PR. and it should accept webhooks from incident-bot when actions are created/updated.
troy: I'll open a small RFC for the dashboard webhook schema. also suggest a lightweight CLI to batch-assign actions from the postmortem json: `ri-actions import pm.json`
jamie: timeline: can someone spin up a small plan? I propose 2-week sprint to land these pieces (1) postmortem-template v2, (2) incident-bot customer-blurb + handoff post, (3) alert grouping tweak, (4) action-dashboard webhook + auto-ticket creation.
priya: volunteering to land the template + integration with docs repo. I'll post a PR with the template and example filled case.
alina: I'll take the alert grouping change and test in staging. PR coming.
troy: I'll prototype bot changes — blurb + create-pm endpoint. will need a small metrics endpoint change to compute top_endpoints.
incident-bot: Quick checklist created: [ ] create-pm endpoint, [ ] handoff template post, [ ] customer blurb generation, [ ] dedupe grouping change hook, [ ] action dashboard webhook
jamie: thanks all. next steps: owners PRs by EOD Thursday; I'll schedule a follow-up sync on Fri 09:30 to review progress. also we should include CS in the Friday sync for the customer-blurb shape.
priya: noted. I'll also add an example `customer_blurb` for the two affected customers from yesterday so we can iterate on tone.
alina: small ops note — can we put a `--suppress-duplicates` flag on test alerts so staging doesn't spam pages? saved my inbox during tests.	:tada:
troy: added `ri-actions` placeholder repo and put a README. link: https://tiny.redwood/ri-actions
jamie: awesome. filing the post-incident follow-up now. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Reminder: Oncall rotation handoff at 11:00.
